digest.component_or_area: llm/config.py file size and gate context separation
propositions: config.py is at 793 LOC against an 800 absolute cap with only 7 lines of headroom, blocking new deprecation aliases like d23e which require 10-16 lines.

Lines 51-152 and 190-269 of config.py (219 total LOC) comprise gate read-root and snapshot-session domain code that is inert since 2026-07-09 and can be safely relocated without breaking dependencies.
The gate context domain (ContextVars, current_code_root, gate_session, assert_gated, etc.) has a proven external consumer in gate_source.py and is a one-way dependency with no circular import risk.
Extracting gate context to a new gate_context.py module reduces config.py to ~631 LOC, creating approximately 15 knobs' worth of runway at the measured 10-13 lines per knob cost.

The assert_gated function hardcodes logging.getLogger('rebar.llm.config') but belongs in gate_context.py after relocation, requiring the logger identity to be re-pointed to reflect the actual module location for audit trail accuracy.
The relocation must require zero test edits and must maintain all monkeypatch targets by re-exporting moved names from llm.config, with no src/ module allowed to import from gate_context directly.
